item.title: Search for Nancy Guthrie continues as FBI offers $50,000 reward for information into her disappearance
item.description: The search for Nancy Guthrie, the 84-year-old mother of ‘TODAY’ co-anchor Savannah Guthrie, intensified Thursday as investigators released a clearer sequence of events from the night she vanished and confirmed that federal authorities are now fully involved.
